_comment: Skip list for `just mcp-health`. Empty today, and it should stay that way if possible.
An entry here means 'this server cannot be probed', and it must say WHY — not 'this server
is allowed to be broken'. The two get confused, and the second is how a health gate stops
Legitimate reasons to skip: a server that needs interactive OAuth (it cannot complete a
handshake headlessly), or one whose startup has an external cost. NOT a legitimate reason:
it is failing and nobody has fixed it.
Note the scope. This probes STDIO servers only — the ones this host spawns. An http/sse
server is someone else's uptime and is out of scope by construction, not by omission.
The estate's own record already distinguishes declared / configured / listening /
session-CONNECTED; this adds the rung STARTS-AND-SERVES, and closes none of the others.
